purpose: Three proven Wiggly songs show the quality bar without locking future brands to one topic.

examples.title: Apple magic, all in one place
whyItWorks: The hook is simple and repeatable.
The verse turns product integration into a buyer benefit.
The brand pronunciation is ordinary and unforced.

examples.title: Need a gift that hits, no time to bake?
whyItWorks: The hook starts with a real buyer moment.
The song sells an outcome rather than listing cookie features.
The rhyme is easy to follow on one listen.

examples.title: Oh Gee Tool, we break the old rules
whyItWorks: The phonetic spelling protects the brand name.
The hook gives the brand a clear attitude.
The verse stays on one contrast between old pain and new result.
